mission: Arrival at the Vectivus asteroid; first tour of the chambers; Vectivus visions begin.
opening_hook: Jacen stepping off the ship's ramp onto an asteroid's internal dock platform.
conflict: Jacen's Jedi sensitivity detecting Sith signatures vs. his philosophical commitment to hearing what Vectivus has to say.
turning_point: Jacen has the first Vectivus vision — a prosperous benefactor at the end of his life, not a screaming monster.
closing_hook: Jacen turning to Ben, who is watching him with an unfamiliar expression.
setting: Vectivus asteroid internal dock and first ante-chamber.
sensory_details: Asteroid's cool rock; ante-chamber's reddish lighting; Vectivus's echo as a faint tonal presence.
emotional_trajectory: Arrival → first Sith-sign → first philosophical confirmation.
notes: Vectivus vision's first sign lands philosophically, not horror-graphically.
